 ARIZONA CARDINALS INJURY REPORT 
 Cardinals-Chiefs injury report: Offensive line help on the way?
 The Arizona Cardinals' center situation could get better against the Kansas City Chiefs.
 BY ARIZONA SPORTS 
 Nov 18, 2026, 4:58 PM 
 Updated: Nov 19, 2026, 11:54 am 
 3 
 Follow on Google News
 Watch: Bickley Blast: Why the odds are stacked against Carson Beck & the Arizona Cardinals vs. Kansas City | 9 mins
 The initial injury report for the Arizona Cardinals’ Week 11 matchup with the Kansas City Chiefs is headlined by the potential for reinforcements to arrive on the offensive line.
 Starting center Hjalte Froholdt practiced in a limited fashion after sitting out all last week due to a concussion, but is not yet out of the protocol. His absence required guard Hayden Connor to start there, and the guy ahead of him is Jon Gaines, who also got limited reps on Wednesday after not practicing all of last week.
 ADVERTISEMENT 
 Starting left tackle Jayden Williams was limited in practice all week last week and did not play in Sunday’s loss. He was limited again on Wednesday.
 Defensive lineman Walter Nolen missed practice due to an illness. Nolen, who has missed two games due to injury this season, played the last two weeks, taking 41 snaps in each Cardinals loss.
 Here is the full injury report for both teams:
